explication: TradingAgents-Astock is an A-share investment-research framework that turns a stock and date into analyst reports and a final trading decision. The principal workflow runs seven A-share-aware analysts, a bull/bear research debate and plan, an A-share-constrained trader proposal, then a three-way risk debate and portfolio decision. Users can initiate analysis through the CLI or Web UI; the Web UI also supports progress and historical-report viewing. README documents the stages and data-source capabilities; unsampled subsystem wiring is shown only where documented.
